titulo: Unit 3: Perfect Tenses & System Monitoring (RA1, RA2, RA4)

paginas.contenido:
Unit 3 focuses on actions that have a connection between the past and the present, or actions that happened before another past event.
  • RA1 & RA2: Technical reading and documentation.
  • RA4: Writing more complex technical descriptions and reports.
  • Grammar Goals: Mastering Present Perfect Continuous, Past Perfect Simple, and Past Perfect Continuous.
  • Vocabulary: Prepositions of place (at/in/on) and monitoring tasks.

💡 Nota: El pasado perfecto es fundamental para explicar la causa de un problema que ya se ha resuelto.

Used for actions that started in the past and continue in the present, focusing on the duration.

Structure:

Subject + Have/Has + Been + Verb-ing

Examples:

  • "We have been monitoring the network traffic since morning."
  • "The IT team has been implementing new features gradually."
  • "I have been working here for five years."

💡 Nota: Usamos 'since' para un punto en el tiempo y 'for' para una duración.

Used for an action that happened before another action in the past.

Structure:

Subject + Had + Past Participle

Examples:

  • "The server had crashed by the time the technician arrived."
  • "He had worked there for five years before he resigned."
  • "They had finished the project before the deadline."

💡 Nota: El Past Perfect es el 'pasado del pasado'.

Used to describe an action that was in progress up to a certain point in the past.

Structure:

Subject + Had + Been + Verb-ing

Examples:

  • "The system had been running smoothly until the power outage."
  • "I had been testing the code for hours when I found the bug."

paginas.titulo: Grammar: Prepositions of Place (In, On, At)
paginas.contenido:
Prepositions can be tricky. Here is how we use them in an office/IT context.
  • IN: Inside a space. "In the corner of the office", "In the server room".
  • ON: On a surface or digital platform. "On the server", "On all the computers", "On the table".
  • AT: A specific point or geographical location. "At the corner of 5th Ave", "At the desk".

💡 Nota: 'In the corner' es dentro de una habitación, 'At the corner' es un cruce de calles.

Key terms for maintaining systems and deploying updates.
  • Monitor: To observe and check the progress or quality of something over time.
  • Implement: To put a decision, plan, or agreement into effect.
  • Deadline: The latest time or date by which something should be completed.
  • Outage: A period when a service or system is unavailable.

Review these core concepts for Unit 3.
  • Present Perfect Continuous: Past to Present (duration). "Have been working".
  • Past Perfect: Before another past action. "Had finished".
  • Past Perfect Continuous: In progress until a past point. "Had been running".
  • Prepositions: ON the server, IN the corner (room), AT the corner (street).
Complete this test to confirm you have mastered the Unit 3 content.

preguntas_test.q: He __________ (work) at the company for five years before he resigned.
preguntas_test.explicacion: Acción que terminó antes de otra en el pasado (resigned) = Past Perfect.

preguntas_test.q: The new software was installed __________ all the computers.
preguntas_test.explicacion: Usamos 'on' para instalaciones en sistemas o dispositivos.

preguntas_test.q: We __________ (monitor) the network traffic since the last upgrade.
preguntas_test.explicacion: Acción que empezó en el pasado y sigue (since) = Present Perfect Continuous.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'I have been waiting for an hour.'

preguntas_test.q: The printer is __________ the corner of the office.
preguntas_test.explicacion: Dentro de una habitación usamos 'in the corner'.

preguntas_test.q: The system __________ (run) smoothly until the power outage.
preguntas_test.explicacion: Acción en desarrollo hasta un punto pasado = Past Perfect Continuous.

preguntas_test.q: The main office is __________ the corner of 5th Avenue and Main Street.
preguntas_test.explicacion: En un cruce de calles usamos 'at the corner'.

preguntas_test.q: By the time the technician arrived, the server __________ (crash).
preguntas_test.explicacion: El fallo ocurrió antes de la llegada (pasado) = Past Perfect.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'The movie had started when we arrived.'

preguntas_test.q: The files are stored __________ a secure server.
preguntas_test.explicacion: Los datos se almacenan 'on a server'.

preguntas_test.q: The team __________ (implement) new features gradually over the past few months.
preguntas_test.explicacion: Proceso gradual que continúa = Present Perfect Continuous.

preguntas_test.q: The team __________ (finish) the project before the deadline.
preguntas_test.explicacion: Completado antes de un tiempo pasado = Past Perfect.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'I had finished my homework by 8 PM.'
